Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 1
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner made an error in the very first step by stating definitive facts ("She was educated at Stanford University... BA in economics (1950) and a law degree from Stanford Law School (LLB, 1952; later JD)") without any supporting evidence from the WebSurfer. The Planner jumped to a conclusion based on internal knowledge rather than following the assigned protocol to "Gather information systematically" and "Build upon previous results" by first querying the web. This premature assumption led to redundant and repetitive search instructions in subsequent steps, as the Planner kept asking the WebSurfer to confirm what it had already assumed to be true, rather than letting the search results drive the understanding.
